List<double> rescaleToUnit(List<double> numbers) {
  if (numbers.isEmpty) return [];
  
  double minVal = numbers.reduce(min);
  double maxVal = numbers.reduce(max);
  double range = maxVal - minVal;
  
  if (range == 0.0) {
    // All elements are the same, return a list of zeros
    return List.filled(numbers.length, 0.0);
  }
  
  return numbers.map((num) => (num - minVal) / range).toList();
}

List<int> sortArray(List<int> arr) {
  if (arr.isEmpty || arr.length == 1) return List.from(arr);
  
  int partition(List<int> list, int left, int right, int pivotIndex) {
    int i = left;
    for (int j = left; j < right; j++) {
      if (list[j] <= list[pivotIndex]) {
        swap(list, i, j);
        i++;
      }
    }

    return i;

  void quickSort(List<int> list, int left, int right) {

    pivotIndex = partition(list, left, right, pivotIndex);
    
    quickSort(list, left, pivotIndex - 1);
    quickSort(list, pivotIndex + 1, right);
  }

  quickSort(arr, 0, arr.length - 1);
  return List.from(arr);
}

List<int> maximum(List<int> arr, int k) {
  if (arr.isEmpty || k <= 0) return [];
  
  final n = arr.length;
  final queue = ListQueue();
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    while (!queue.isEmpty && arr[queue.last] < arr[i]) {
      queue.removeLast();
    }
    queue.add(i);
    
    // Remove elements out of the current window
    while (queue.first <= i - k) {
      queue.removeFirst();
    }
    
    // When we have at least one element in the queue and it's past the first k-1 elements
    if (i >= k - 1) {
      return [arr[queue.first]];
    }
  }
  return [];
}

class ListQueue extends Iterable<int> with IteratorMixin<int> {
  final _list = <int>[];
  
  @override
  bool moveNext() => _list.isNotEmpty && super.moveNext();
  
  @override
  int get current => _list[currentIndex];
  
  int get currentIndex => _list.length > 0 ? _list.length - 1 : 0;
  
  void add(int value) => _list.add(value);
  
  int removeLast() => _list.removeLast();
  
  int removeFirst() => _list.removeAt(0);
}
